messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的網球排名。若您需要最新資訊，建議查看官方 ATP（男子）或 WTA（女子）網站、或使用專門的體育數據服務。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？" (Who is currently ranked number one tennis player?). We need to retrieve current ranking. Use the function sports_team_standing? But that's for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual ranking. We might need to answer with knowledge. But we don't have real-time data. We can say we don't have up-to-date info. But maybe we can approximate: As of 2023, men's top is Novak Djokovic or Carlos Alcaraz? Actually as of 2023, Djokovic was top. For women, Iga Swiatek. But "currently" could be 2026. We can't know. So we should respond that we don't have real-time data. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. So we can say we don't have current ranking.
